cohort: 708 singleton infants born following IVF, from a single clinic in France, between December 2013 and March 2017
finding: Birthweight was higher for infants born following frozen embryo transfer compared to fresh embryo transfer, after adjusting for confounding factors.
mod_finding: The caesarean section rate was higher for infants born following frozen embryo transfer compared to fresh embryo transfer (21% vs 16%).
birth_weight: Mean birthweight was 3357g after frozen embryo transfer versus 3183g after fresh embryo transfer
